d: Anger is mounting in Pakistan-Occupied Kashmir as thousands protest against Pakistan's Army and Field Marshal Asim Munir following deadly clashes that left civilians dead. With unrest spreading across PoJK, Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, pressure is growing on Islamabad amid rising calls for freedom. Meanwhile, the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) has officially come into force, offering duty-free access for most Indian exports while promising lower tariffs on select British products, stronger investment and new opportunities for trade, jobs and economic…
